title: Johnson arithmetic inequality
statement:
Let $n$, $d$, and $w$ be natural numbers with $n > 0$ and $2d \le n$, and write $\alpha = \alpha(n,d)$ for the shift parameter and $J_2(n,d)$ for the binary Johnson radius. If $w \le J_2(n,d)$, then
\[
(n - 2d) + \alpha^2\, n + 2\alpha\,(2w - n) \;\le\; 0.
\]
replaced:
If $n > 0$, $2d \le n$, and $w \le J_2(n,d)$, then for $\alpha = \alpha(n,d)$
\[
(n - 2d) + \alpha^2 n + 2\alpha\,(2w - n) \;\le\; 0.
\]
